questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of Binary Search?
questions.explanation: Binary search divides the search interval in half with each comparison, yielding O(log n) time complexity.

questions.question: Which OOP principle involves hiding internal implementation details and exposing only necessary interfaces?
questions.explanation: Encapsulation bundles data with code and restricts unauthorized external access.

questions.question: In a Queue, the insertion operation at the rear is called:
questions.explanation: Enqueue adds an element to the rear of the queue; Dequeue removes from front.

questions.question: Which sorting algorithm operates on the divide-and-conquer paradigm with O(n log n) average time complexity?
questions.explanation: Merge Sort recursively divides the list into halves, sorts them, and merges them in O(n log n).

questions.question: What is the output of len([1, 2, 3, [4, 5]]) in Python?
questions.explanation: The list contains 4 elements: three integers (1, 2, 3) and one nested list ([4, 5]).
